instruction: Instruct me on launching the Brightness-Contrast adjustment panel.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Brightness-Contrast adjustment window in GIMP. The evaluator checks GIMP's action-history file for the 'colors-brightness-contrast' action. This is one of the most basic color adjustment tools in GIMP.
metadata.verification: Verified that GIMP's action-history tracks color adjustment operations. Brightness-Contrast is accessed via Colors > Brightness-Contrast, following the same pattern as the original Vignette filter task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses GIMP's action-history file to verify that Brightness-Contrast window was opened
Metric 'check_include_exclude' properly checks for 'colors-brightness-contrast' action and excludes error messages
Expected value 'colors-brightness-contrast' matches GIMP's internal action naming convention
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP to flush action-history to disk and handles save dialogs
Complete coverage: instruction only requires opening the window, evaluator verifies this single requirement
Practical and correct: action-history is a documented GIMP feature, file path is standard for GIMP 2.10
